facts.business: Starcom Information Technology Limited is engaged in information technology services and solutions.

auditor.name: M/s. CAS & Co. (Formerly known as K.M Tulsian & Associates), Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) Overdue statutory dues of Rs. 1629.08 lacs (Sales Tax/GST Rs. 248.30 lacs, PF/ESIC/PT Rs. 209.74 lacs, TDS Rs. 1171.04 lacs) with unascertained consequential impacts; (b) Non-provision of rent expense of Rs. 607.15 lacs for Apr 2019-Jul 2024 for premises jointly owned by promoter; (c) Intangible assets under development of Rs. 2431.02 lacs not completed since long with no audit evidence on future economic benefits or impairment; (d) Rs. 1000 lacs received from City builder shown as other current liability due to absence of relevant documents to conclude nature of transaction. Material uncertainty related to going concern as net worth fully eroded, cash losses incurred, and current liabilities exceed current assets.

key_risks: Overdue statutory dues of Rs. 1629.08 lacs with unascertained consequential impacts
Non-provision of rent expense of Rs. 607.15 lacs for premises jointly owned by promoter
Intangible assets under development of Rs. 2431.02 lacs not completed since long with impairment uncertainty
Material uncertainty related to going concern: net worth fully eroded, cash losses, current liabilities exceed current assets
Substantial utilization of funds towards intangible assets under development causing working capital stress
facts.related_party_note: Rent of Rs. 660.81 lakhs (net of TDS) up to 31st March 2019 unpaid for premises jointly owned by one of the promoters along with his business partner. Management in discussions for waiver/reduction. Rent expense of Rs. 607.15 lakhs for Apr 2019-Jul 2024 not provided. Rs. 1000 lakhs received from City builder (new buyer of land) as compensation for vacating premises leased for 40 years between earlier owner and Mr. Ziaulla Sheriff (Director), shown as other current liability due to absence of relevant documents.
